propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every Gerrit patchset due to PYSEC-2026-2132 command-injection vulnerability in click 8.2.1, blocking all Verified +1 votes
click is pinned at 8.2.1 in uv.lock via transitive dependency from inspect-ai, which caps click below 8.2.2 across all available versions
uv lock --upgrade-package click is a no-op because it only permits movement within existing constraint set, not lifting upstream caps
click version can be bumped to 8.4.2 by adding override-dependencies directive to pyproject.toml, which replaces the inspect-ai cap at workspace resolution level only
inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and runs under click 8.4.2 despite stale upstream cap, making the override safe and defensible

fix is implemented via [tool.uv] override-dependencies = ['click>=8.3.3'] plus lock refresh, minimal blast radius to this repo's environments only, with removal condition tied to upstream PR UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai#4596
